days.title: 끼꼬 – 에오조
days.morning: Speedboat to Ky Co, swim and snorkel at Bai Dua.
days.afternoon: Eo Gio – sea views from the cliff-top walkway.
days.evening: Jumping-shrimp bánh xèo and a walk along Xuan Dieu seafront.

days.title: 꾸이년 시내
days.morning: Ghenh Rang Tien Sa and the tomb of poet Han Mac Tu.
days.afternoon: The Twin Towers and Long Khanh Pagoda.
days.evening: Seafood at Quy Nhon night market.

days.title: 떠이선 – 무술의 고장
days.morning: Quang Trung Museum and a traditional martial arts show.
days.afternoon: Banh It towers and bánh hỏi with pork offal porridge.

days.title: 꾸라오싸인 섬
days.morning: Boat to Cu Lao Xanh and its lighthouse.
days.afternoon: Swim, snorkel and eat island seafood.
days.evening: Back on the mainland for coffee with a sea view.

days.title: 혼코 – 년리
days.morning: Nhon Ly fishing village and a basket boat to Hon Kho.
days.afternoon: Snorkel and swim at Hon Kho.
days.evening: Buy fish cakes and Cho Huyen fermented pork as gifts.
